title: The Sermon on the Mount
aka: Sermon on the Plain English Translation
lead: Jesus' longest recorded teaching, in Matthew 5–7, with a shorter form in Luke 6:20–49. It opens with the Beatitudes, interprets the Law of Moses, teaches on prayer, money and judging, and ends with a call to build on Jesus' words. No passage of the Gospels has been quoted, argued over and lived by more.
